assumptions.statement: Physical isolation or valve closure is feasible without claiming engineering validity.
Emergency water_reserve dependency order must be verified against micro_commons_cycle_iteration.json.

expected_effects.rationale: Isolation limits contamination spread; ratio changes reflect supply shift.
Prevents health unmet demand from contaminated water.

hypothesis: Isolating node_water_reserve from structure_common_house supply line during risk mode reduces exposure to contamination risk without requiring new survival-critical unmet demand.

queries: water reserve isolation mechanics dependency order emergency fallback maintenance labor availability

risk_tradeoffs.mitigation: Ensure fallback from emergency_water_reserve exists in dependency order.
Coordinate with community_kitchen and shared_bathhouse maintenance hours from baseline simulations.
risk_tradeoffs.risk: Labor for maintenance may exceed available_commons_hours

acceptance_tests: No new survival-critical unmet demand is introduced.
Water access reduction is mitigated by alternate supply modeling.

title: Water reserve source isolation protocol
